name: Live Notifications
description: Makes notifications that replace themselves update in place. Any app that re-sends a notification with the same ID (notify-send -r, progress bars from downloaders, music players, copy dialogs) currently keeps showing its first text in the notch, because the shell copies a notification's fields once and never looks again. With this mod the notch and the history follow every update, and a replaced notification that had already timed out pops back up with a fresh timer, the way other notification daemons behave.
author: drpezzer
